title: Single Source of Truth
description: Every piece of knowledge or configuration has exactly one owner.
name: Single Source of Truth
statement: The Single Source of Truth (SSOT) is the practice of structuring information models and associated data schemas such that every data element is mastered (owned) in exactly one place.
intuition: Duplicate copies of data or code naturally diverge over time. To maintain system integrity and ease maintenance, designate a single authoritative source for every piece of information, and reference it everywhere else.
implications: No duplicated model definitions or schema classes.
System parameters are declared in centralized configs and imported by components.
Easier maintenance and updates as adjustments only need to be applied to the master source.
limitations: May introduce query latencies if distant components must repeatedly query the central master rather than accessing cached local copies.
Can create single points of failure if the source system becomes unavailable.
